records.requirement: Verify HMAC-SHA256 over timestamp + dot + exact raw bytes with v1 and constant-time comparison.
records.acceptance_oracle: Known offline vector verifies; one byte change or reserialization rejects.

records.requirement: Reject malformed/missing/contradictory timestamp, v0-only, unsupported signature shape; apply absolute 300-second freshness.
records.acceptance_oracle: 299/300-second values pass freshness; 301 and conflicts reject.

records.requirement: Unavailable secret/clock and unsupported input fail closed with safe diagnostics.
records.acceptance_oracle: Nonzero/safe reason; no secret, raw body or header in output.

records.requirement: Verification cannot itself create a receipt, paid admission or 2xx.
records.acceptance_oracle: Consumer returns typed verification result; no route/receipt/outbox in this slice.

records.requirement: Minimize diagnostic data and keep provider/customer secrets out of logs and fixtures.
records.acceptance_oracle: Forbidden-marker assertions pass on safe stdout/stderr/log fields.

records.requirement: Use deterministic synthetic checks and report actual evidence without unsupported performance claims.
records.acceptance_oracle: Same fixed fixture/clock gives same result; command, SHA, tool versions and exit recorded.

human_gates: blind clarity check by another student
limitations: No live Stripe deliveries or credentials
No financial eligibility or source-read proof
